steps.message: I’ll update the dependency in the local Maven manifests, inspect the compile failures against the new JDT version, then make the smallest production-code changes needed and verify with Maven.

todos.content: Find Maven manifests and current JDT dependency version
Apply org.eclipse.jdt.core 3.42.0 upgrade and regenerate metadata if present
Run targeted Maven verification to identify failures
Patch production code for JDT 3.42.0 compatibility
